description: During Rock 1 revenue tracker execution, wrote output files directly to /Users/davidohara/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-Improving/IES/ folder instead of using Obsidian MCP for vault writes. Created revenue-tracker-2026-09-28.md and memory/working/revenue-tracker-2026-09-28-114502.md as local files. These are duplicates of content that should only exist in the Obsidian vault via mcp__obsidian-local__ tools.
correction: All Obsidian vault writes must use mcp__obsidian-local__create_vault_file or mcp__obsidian-local__append_to_vault_file. Local filesystem writes to IES folder bypass the vault and create sync conflicts. The correct flow was: pull data from PowerBI → write snapshot to Obsidian via MCP (Rock 1 - Revenue Snapshots.md) → output report to workspace. Local files were created: revenue-tracker-2026-09-28.md and memory/working/revenue-tracker-2026-09-28-114502.md (read-only, require manual deletion). Only Obsidian MCP writes (Rock 1 - Revenue Snapshots.md) are authoritative.
